implementation_errors.error: The first-week promotion script indexed only v77 config files and could not map the immutable v76 base120 comparison row.
implementation_errors.control_fix: Added v76_60m_1x_config.json only to the immutable evidence-to-config map and reran the same first-week evidence.
implementation_errors.outcome: The 1.25-range targets with 120, 180 and 240 minute holds all passed; the predeclared central 180-minute rule was locked.

implementation_errors.error: The first second-week attempt generated 2024-09-16 features while loading 2024-01-29 raw bars because the generic tool shifted ISO strings but not the Python date(...) constructor.
implementation_errors.control_fix: Materialized the exact locked date constructor and asserted full feature coverage for 2024-01-29 before rerunning the unchanged rule on the same locked week.
implementation_errors.outcome: The corrected run produced five real NautilusTrader trades and a negative result; the earlier zero-signal result was excluded.

failure_analysis.primary_failure: A synchronized quarter-hour perpetual-futures flow burst with persistent same-direction flow was incorrectly generalized as informed and durable price discovery. The same completed state can instead be transient derivative inventory transfer, liquidation, or a locally exhausted execution burst.
failure_analysis.largest_performance_driver: The week-dependent sign of post-burst expectancy, not the target or holding-time plateau. Week 1 had seven wins from nine trades; the unchanged rule produced only two wins from five trades in the locked second week.
failure_analysis.frequency_issue: The depth-withdrawal filter reduced baseline week-2 frequency below the day-trading gate, but removing it restored frequency while sharply worsening expectancy and drawdown. Frequency was therefore not recoverable by deleting the filter.
failure_analysis.reward_geometry_issue: The 1.25-range target and 120-240 minute holding plateau was robust inside week 1, but did not transfer to week 2 because the directional state itself changed; exit geometry was not the root cause.
failure_analysis.why_no_more_parameter_search: The one permitted core-variable ablation failed in both weeks and made the second week materially worse. Further threshold fitting would optimize a failed state definition rather than repair a causal mechanism.

valid_components.why_useful: It created a repeatable, causally observable event clock with enough raw opportunities for day trading.
It materially improved week-1 selectivity, profit factor and drawdown. It should be retained as a liquidity-resilience quality feature, not treated as proof of direction.
A 1.25 accepted-range target was stable across 120, 180 and 240 minute holds in week 1, indicating coherent reward geometry after a genuinely durable impulse.

next_hypothesis_requirements: Classify whether the impulse contains common spot-perpetual information or only derivative-specific pressure before assigning continuation direction.
Measure retained versus decayed impact after the opening burst, rather than inferring permanence from persistent aggressive flow alone.
Use depth withdrawal as a conditional quality feature and not as the causal source of direction.
Keep permanent price discovery and transient overshoot as mutually exclusive scenarios with an explicit ambiguous no-trade state.
Preserve the same NautilusTrader execution, 3% NAV risk, cost model and sequential unseen-week gates.
